import { useState } from "react" export default function UseStatePage() { const [counter, setCounter] = useState(0) const [car, setCar] = useState({ brand: "Toyota", model: "Pirus", year: "2010", color: "white", }) const changeCar = (car) => { setCar({ brand: car.brand, model: car.model, year: car.year, color: car.color }) } return (

Counter: {counter}

Car Information

Brand: {car.brand}

Model: {car.model}

Year: {car.year}

Color: {car.color}

) }
